name: synthetism
description: The SSI stack — keys, did, credential, schema-engine, query, resolve, engine-ajv, vc, vp, signer. One repository; npm workspaces only.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @synthetism/keys && npm run build -w @synthetism/did && npm run build -w @synthetism/credential && npm run build -w @synthetism/schema-engine && npm run build -w @synthetism/query && npm run build -w @synthetism/resolve && npm run build -w @synthetism/engine-ajv && npm run build -w @synthetism/vc && npm run build -w @synthetism/vp && npm run build -w @synthetism/signer
